messages.content: Write one complete Python3 module containing coalesce_ranges(ranges) plus unittest tests. Input is a list of pairs of integer half-open bounds [start,end). Reject bool and non-integer endpoints with TypeError; reject start>end with ValueError. Drop zero-length ranges. Return a sorted list of disjoint (start,end) tuples, merging overlaps and touching intervals. Never mutate input, including on errors. Handle negative and large integers. Use only the standard library. Include independent-looking tests for every rule. Return only the module, without prose.
